title: Junior Market Research Analyst
description:
**Job description:**

Company: MagicMinds Technologies Limited

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Experience: 3 months to 6 months in market research,
Marketing Research, Consumer Insights, Business Research, or a related role.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Mode: Work From Office

***INTERESTED CANDIDATES, SHARE YOUR CV TO tama@magicminds.io***

**About the Role :**
MagicMinds Technologies Limited is looking for a Market Research Analyst with 3 months–6 months of experience to support our business and marketing initiatives through market research, competitor analysis, consumer insights, and data-driven recommendations. The ideal candidate should have strong research and analytical skills, a good understanding of market trends, and the ability to convert research findings into clear and actionable business insights.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Conduct primary and secondary market research to understand industry trends, customer preferences, and market opportunities.
* Research and analyse competitors, including their products/services, pricing, positioning, marketing strategies, and target customers.
* Collect, organise, and analyse market and customer data from various reliable sources.
* Conduct surveys, interviews, questionnaires, and online research to gather relevant insights.
* Identify market trends, customer needs, gaps, and potential business opportunities.
* Prepare detailed research reports, presentations, and data-driven recommendations.
* Support marketing and business teams with relevant market intelligence and insights.
* Monitor industry developments and competitor activities on a regular basis.
* Analyse research findings and communicate key insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain and update research databases, reports, and relevant market information.
* Assist in evaluating new markets, products, services, and business opportunities.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Business Management, or a related field will be an advantage.
* 3 months–6 months of experience in Market Research, Marketing Research, Consumer Insights, Business Research, or a related role.
* Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of market research methodologies and competitor analysis.
* Ability to interpret data and convert findings into meaningful business insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.
* Familiarity with online research tools, Google Forms, surveys, and data collection methods.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a curious, analytical mindset.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in conducting primary and secondary research.
* Knowledge of consumer behaviour and market trends.
* Experience preparing research reports and business presentations.
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Trends, Google Forms, Excel, PowerPoint, Canva, Notion, or AI-based research tools.
* Exposure to marketing, competitor intelligence, or business analysis.

title: Merchandiser
description:
The Merchandiser will be responsible for merchandise planning, assortment management, inventory monitoring, sales analysis, and coordination with internal teams to ensure the right products are available at the right stores, at the right time and in the right quantities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and manage product assortment based on sales trends, store requirements, seasonality, and customer demand.
* Monitor
  **sales, stock levels, sell-through, stock cover, ageing, and inventory movement**
  across stores/categories.
* Analyse product performance and identify
  **fast-moving and slow-moving SKUs**
  .
* Coordinate with Buying, Design, Production, Warehouse, Retail Operations, and Supply Chain teams for smooth merchandise flow.
* Ensure timely
  **allocation, replenishment and stock transfers**
  across stores.
* Prepare and maintain regular
  **MIS reports**
  , including sales analysis, stock reports, category performance, ageing, and inventory reports.
* Support seasonal and promotional merchandise planning, including new product launches.
* Recommend markdowns, promotions, stock transfers, or liquidation plans for slow-moving inventory.
* Track category-wise, store-wise, and SKU-wise performance against targets.
* Assist in demand forecasting and inventory planning to minimize
  **stock-outs and excess inventory**
  .
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to understand pricing, assortment, trends, and customer preferences.
* Coordinate with stores to understand merchandise requirements and resolve stock-related concerns.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of
  **retail merchandising and inventory management**
  .
* Good analytical and numerical ability.
* Strong knowledge of
  **MS Excel**
  , including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and reporting.
* Understanding of
  **sell-through, stock cover, ageing, inventory turnover and assortment planning**
  .
* Working knowledge of ERP/POS systems would be an advantage.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large volumes of data.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment.

**Qualification**

* Prior experience in
  **apparel, fashion, lifestyle, footwear, accessories, or organized retail**
  would be an advantage.

title: Senior Database Tech Lead
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Database Tech Lead to lead our database development and optimization initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server along with the ability to guide and mentor a team of SQL developers. You will be responsible for ensuring high performance, enforcing best practices, and driving continuous improvements. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align database strategies with business objectives. This role is ideal for professionals with strong technical leadership, a strategic mindset, and a passion for building high-performing teams and systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Lead the development, and maintenance of high-performance databases using Microsoft SQL Server (2019/Latest versions).

• Architect scalable, secure, and reliable database solutions aligned with business needs.

• Review, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and functions.

• Define and enforce database development standards, best practices, and coding guidelines.

• Drive performance tuning, query optimization, and database scalability initiatives.

• Mentor and manage a team of SQL developers; provide technical guidance and conduct code reviews.

• Plan and allocate tasks, track progress, and ensure timely delivery of database-related activities.

• Identify opportunities for automation, innovation, and process improvements.

• Stay updated with the latest database technologies, tools, and industry best practices.

• Oversee and support reporting solutions including SSRS (preferred). Candidate Profile

• 9-14 years of experience in database development and management using Microsoft SQL Server.

• Strong expertise in MS SQL, T-SQL, query optimization, and performance tuning.

• Proven experience in leading and managing a team of developers.

• Hands-on experience with SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).

• Experience in database architecture design and large-scale data handling.

• Exposure to SSRS or other reporting tools is preferred.

• Strong understanding of data security, indexing, and database optimization techniques.

• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and drive technical excellence.

title: Branch Product Head
description:
**Company Description**
Shriram Finance Limited is one of India’s largest retail Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), offering credit solutions across commercial vehicles, two-wheelers, cars, gold loans, personal loans, and small business loans. As part of the 50-year-old Shriram Group, the company has built a strong reputation as a trusted financial partner focused on improving customers’ lives. In November 2022, Shriram Transport Finance Company Limited, Shriram City Union Finance Limited, and Shriram Capital Limited merged to form Shriram Finance Limited. As of March 31, 2026, Shriram Finance operates through a network of 3,225 branches with a workforce of 76,241, managing combined Assets Under Management of ₹3.02 lakh crores. The organization offers opportunities for growth in a high-impact, customer-centric financial services environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Branch Product Head is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata, responsible for driving product performance and growth at the branch level. This role oversees the implementation of product strategies across lending segments, monitors product profitability, and ensures alignment with organizational goals and regulatory guidelines. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing branch product performance, reviewing key metrics, and identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio quality. The Branch Product Head collaborates closely with branch leadership, sales teams, and central product teams to refine offerings, execute local marketing initiatives, and ensure that customer needs are effectively addressed. The role also involves conducting market assessments, supporting new product or feature rollouts, providing product training to branch staff, and ensuring adherence to risk and compliance standards.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Product Strategy and Product Management skills to design, implement, and optimize branch-level product portfolios.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills and Market Research capabilities to interpret data, understand local market dynamics, and identify growth opportunities.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to coordinate with branch teams, senior management, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Relevant experience in retail lending or NBFC/financial services, particularly in commercial vehicle, consumer, or small business products, is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field is preferred, along with strong knowledge of credit processes, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated leadership ability, stakeholder management, and proficiency in using MS Excel, dashboards, and reporting tools will be an advantage.

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Business Process Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Business Process Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Design business processes, including characteristics and key performance indicators (KPIs), to meet process and functional requirements. Work closely with the Application Architect to create the process blueprint and establish business process requirements to drive out application requirements and metrics. Assist in quality management reviews, ensure all business and design requirements are met. Educate stakeholders to ensure a complete understanding of the designs.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
SAP MM Materials Management, SAP Ariba
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Business Process Architect, a typical day involves designing comprehensive business processes that align with organizational goals and performance standards. This role requires close collaboration with various stakeholders to develop detailed process blueprints and ensure that all functional requirements are clearly defined and met. The position also includes participating in quality management activities to verify that business and design specifications are fulfilled. Additionally, the role involves educating and guiding stakeholders to foster a thorough understanding of the process designs, ensuring smooth implementation and continuous improvement across the organization.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and refinement of business process frameworks to enhance operational efficiency.
* Facilitate communication between technical and business teams to ensure alignment of objectives.
* Support junior team members by providing guidance and knowledge sharing to foster professional growth.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP),
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with SAP Ariba, SAP MM Materials Management.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and optimize business processes.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear process documentation.
* Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive process improvements.
* Familiarity with quality management principles and performance measurement techniques.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
* This position is based at our KDC1A - SEZ location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

We are seeking an experienced
**Data Scientist**
with strong hands-on experience in
**Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AWS services**

* Build and evaluate AI assistants, agents, and knowledge-based applications.

* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into data science use cases.
* Conduct requirements discussions, workshops, technical sessions, and solution demonstrations.

* Experience with NLP, document intelligence, predictive analytics, or fraud/anomaly detection use cases.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, and data privacy principles.
* Experience in Public Service or Government projects would be an advantage.

**Position Summary**
**Tax Consultant II**
**, Tax Services**
**–**

Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Tax Consultant II to support clients as they modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will help translate and support tax and business requirements into technology-enabled solutions that improve compliance, reporting, and operational efficiency. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams on projects that help large organizations build scalable tax functions.

As a
**Tax Consultant II**
on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Resolve day-to-day issues raised by users, analyze root cause and provide quick solutions.
* Troubleshooting daily system issues, managing user requests, and resolving incidents within agreed [Service Level Agreements (SLAs)].
* Supporting the delivery of tax technology and tax transformation projects for clients across industries

* Collaborating with tax, technology, and client stakeholders to identify process improvement opportunities

**The team**
Tax Transformation Consulting helps clients respond to increased regulatory requirements and greater scrutiny by building tax functions that are strategic, agile, and focused on business value. The practice supports organizations in moving from their current state to the next generation of tax operations through process improvement, technology enablement, and operating model transformation.
  
  
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting professionals work across tax, technology, organizational change, and co-sourcing disciplines to help connect global business strategies with practical tax function solutions. The team brings together specialized experience to help clients improve efficiency, manage risk, and enhance the performance of their tax departments.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
10 AM to 7 PM or 11 AM to 8 PM
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or Economics

title: Amazon Ads manager
description:
**Company Description**
ONEAT is a food brand built on the belief that eating better should be simple, not driven by trends or complicated wellness routines. The company focuses on helping people make more thoughtful choices every day through accessible, better-for-you food options. ONEAT designs products that are easy to understand and select, avoiding confusing labels and unnecessary complexity. By encouraging small, consistent improvements “one-at-a-time,” ONEAT aims to make better food a natural part of daily life. Candidates joining ONEAT will contribute to a mission centered on mindful eating and practical wellness.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Amazon Ads Manager role based in Kolkata. The Amazon Ads Manager will oversee the planning, execution, and optimization of Amazon advertising campaigns to drive visibility, sales, and brand growth for ONEAT’s product portfolio. Daily responsibilities include managing campaign structures, monitoring performance metrics, analyzing data, and adjusting bids and targeting strategies to improve return on ad spend. The role also involves coordinating with marketing and sales teams to align advertising initiatives with product launches, promotions, and brand messaging, as well as preparing regular performance reports and insights for internal stakeholders. The Amazon Ads Manager will be expected to stay current with Amazon advertising tools, policies, and best practices to ensure compliant and effective campaigns.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written reporting and effective cross-functional collaboration.
* Candidates should possess Sales-related skills such as understanding conversion drivers, revenue optimization, and customer buying behavior on Amazon.
* Candidates should possess Marketing skills, including campaign planning, audience segmentation, and brand positioning in an e-commerce environment.
* Candidates should possess Advertising skills with hands-on experience in Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and performance analysis.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to handle multiple campaigns, timelines, and stakeholders while maintaining attention to detail.
* Experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central, e-commerce analytics tools, and data-driven decision-making is highly beneficial.
* Relevant education in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in digital advertising or e-commerce is preferred.

* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

**Candidate Evidence Expected**
Candidates should be prepared to provide concrete examples from recent o9 engagements, including:
  
  

* Their exact role, duration, and ownership in each o9 project.
* INT3.0 interfaces designed or delivered, source and target systems, data volumes or cadence, and production responsibilities.
* Examples of complex incidents diagnosed and permanently resolved.
* Examples of integration design documents, runbooks, monitoring approaches, or error-management practices they created.
* Python solutions personally developed and the business or operational problem addressed.
* Current o9 certifications and evidence of relevant o9 training completion.

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: TC-CS-SRCR-Staff-Supply Chain and Third-Party Risk Management
description:

**Staff – AI Third Party Risk Analyst (Third Party Security Assessment)**
**Experience: 1–4 Years**
**Role Summary**
The AI Third Party Risk Analyst is an entry-level role responsible for supporting the execution of Third-Party Security Assessments (TPSA) and Vendor Due Diligence processes. The analyst works within the Cyber Risk and Compliance team, applying foundational knowledge of third-party risk management (TPRM) frameworks, supply chain security principles, AI security for third parties and use of AI-enabled tools for Third Party Security Assessment. This role provides exposure to third party risk management lifecycle, onboarding assessment, and AI-assisted assessment & monitoring capabilities while building core competencies in cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and data-driven risk evaluation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end Third-Party Security Assessment (TPSA) activities including vendor intake, initial risk screening, assessor evaluation against industry specific standards/regulations and documentation of assessment findings.
* Assist in conducting vendor due diligence reviews by collecting, reviewing, and validating vendor-provided security evidence and questionnaire responses.
* Evaluate AI security practices of third parties wherever applicable.
* Participate in the risk assessment lifecycle from vendor onboarding through ongoing monitoring, escalation, and offboarding.
* Maintain and update TPRM risk registers, risk logs, and vendor risk profiles in GRC tools or risk management platforms.
* Support supply chain risk identification activities by flagging vendors with elevated exposure across IT, cloud, and operational domains.
* Assist senior team members in preparing risk assessment reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.
* Use and implement AI-enabled solutions for automated questionnaire/evidence analysis, gap identification, issue description and identification of risk treatment plans to accelerate risk evaluation.
* Track vendor remediation progress against identified control gaps and support follow-up activities.
* Maintain compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2 and more), and sector-specific requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of TPRM workflows, templates, and assessment methodologies.

**Education / Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technology, Business, Risk Management, or related discipline.
* Relevant certifications are advantageous (e.g., CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 , ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, other TPRM certifications).

**AI & Cyber Certifications**
**Cyber Security Certifications (Required / Advantageous):**

* CompTIA Security+ – Foundational cybersecurity knowledge covering threats, vulnerabilities, and risk management.
* ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation – Understanding of Information Security Management System (ISMS) principles.
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) – Entry-level awareness of IT/cyber risk concepts (pursuing).

**AI & Data Certifications:**

* Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) – Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts on cloud platforms.
* Google Cloud Digital Leader – Awareness of AI and cloud services applicable to risk assessment contexts.
* IBM AI Foundations for Business – Introduction to AI concepts including machine learning and automation.
* Coursera / edX AI for Everyone (Andrew Ng) – Broad awareness of AI applications in business and risk management.

**Skills & Experience**
**Required Skills:**

* 0–4 years of experience in cyber risk, third-party risk, information security, or related field.
* Basic understanding of Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) frameworks and vendor assessment processes.
* Familiarity with risk assessment lifecycle stages: identification, evaluation, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, and CIS Controls.
* Knowledge of AI governance standards as ISO 42001. Understanding of AI security, especially in context of third-party security.
* Understanding of supply chain risk concepts including vendor tiering and dependency mapping.
* Ability to review and validate vendor security questionnaires (e.g., SIG, CAIQ, custom questionnaires).
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for risk tracking and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and written communication skills.

**Good to Have Skills (including AI):**

* Exposure to GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, ProcessUnity) for risk tracking.
* Awareness of AI-enabled risk scoring tools and automated vendor intelligence platforms (e.g., BitSight, Security Scorecard, RiskRecon).
* Basic understanding of predictive modelling concepts applied to vendor risk prioritization.
* Familiarity with AI-driven questionnaire automation and NLP-based document analysis tools.
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as Excel Power Query, Power BI, or similar for risk dashboards.
* Interest in emerging AI technologies including machine learning applications in cyber risk management.
* Awareness of Graph AI concepts for mapping vendor relationships and supply chain dependencies.

**AI Tools Skillset**
**Vendor Risk & Scoring Tools:**

* BitSight / Security Scorecard / RiskRecon – Awareness and basic navigation for vendor cyber ratings and continuous monitoring signals.
* GRC Tools – Familiarity with vendor risk management workflow tools for questionnaire tracking and risk registers.

**GRC & Automation Platforms:**

* ServiceNow GRC – Basic usage for risk logging, vendor profiles, and assessment task management.
* Microsoft Power Automate – Introductory exposure to workflow automation for risk data collection and notifications.

**Data Analytics & Reporting:**

* Microsoft Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables) – Risk data aggregation, vendor scoring worksheets, and basic dashboard creation.
* Microsoft Power BI – Consuming pre-built risk dashboards and understanding risk KPIs.

**AI Awareness Tools:**

* ChatGPT / Microsoft Copilot – Basic use for summarizing vendor documentation, drafting risk findings, and accelerating report writing.
* Bing AI / Google Gemini – Research assistance for vendor background checks and regulatory lookups.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Deliver assigned modules with quality and timeliness.
* Collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrate learning agility in AI and cyber risk domains.
* Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives.
* Show curiosity and proactively develop skills in AI-enabled risk management.

description:

India (Remote)
  
  
Job Overview:
  
  
The Grants Specialist I leads study-specific investigator grant administration services as an integral member of the team. The role creates budget templates and subsequent budget interpretation, performs site payment processing, quality control activities, financial record maintenance, accruals, forecasting, and associated study financial activities. The Grants Specialist I works closely with other members of the global Grants Administration team and collaborates cross-functionally with Project Management, Contracts, Finance, Clinical, and other applicable stakeholders throughout all phases of the study.
  
  
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
  
  
Conducts with supervision and support –
  
  

* Coordinates site payment activities across the lifecycle of assigned studies serving as the primary site payment contact for the study team.
* Reviews and interprets site contracts, study protocols, schedules of assessments, and payment language to identify site payment requirements.
* Works with clinical study teams to finalize negotiated site budgets and ensure payment tracking systems are configured in accordance with contractual requirements and payment expectations.
* Creates and maintains budget templates, individual site budgets, payee information, and payment schedules in designated payment tracking and financial systems; coordinates with Project Management, Finance, Contracts, and Legal, as necessary.
* Tracks executed site contracts and follows up on missing payment-related documentation, including W-9s or other required administrative records.
* Develops and maintains site payment forecasting models based on approved study budgets, country allocations, study assumptions, and current study circumstances; provides periodic estimates to support financial planning and reporting.
* Performs quality control reviews of site budgets, invoices, payment schedules, and related grant information in designated systems.
* Reviews, verifies, and processes site payments in collaboration with Project Management and Finance, ensuring accuracy, compliance with contractual requirements, and adherence to established timelines.
* Responds to payment inquiries from study teams, sponsors, and sites; coordinates communications and issue resolution to support study priorities and established timelines.
* Codes and maintains invoices and supporting documentation by establishing, maintaining, and reconciling site financial records in accordance with applicable financial principles, Caidya procedures, and sponsor requirements.
* Prepares, manages, monitors, and reconciles grant payment accruals, including year-end accrual estimates, partnering with Finance to develop applicable financial reporting.
* Provides site payment documentation and supporting records for audits and internal reviews, as required.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by departmental management.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
  
  
No routine direct supervisory responsibility. May provide study-level task direction and technical guidance to Grants Coordinators as assigned to responsible studies.
  
  
Job Requirements:
  
  
Education:
  
  

* College or university degree. A healthcare, life science, finance, or related degree is a plus.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.

Experience:
  
  

* Typically minimum of four years of experience in clinical research, site payments, grant administration, finance, accounting, or a related function.
* Experience coordinating site payments and working with global study teams.

Skills/Competencies:
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with global internal and external study teams
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and site payment systems
* Knowledge of the clinical trial lifecycle
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent focus on quality
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and timelines
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and changing environment
* Demonstrate honesty, trust, fairness, cooperation, self-control, and flexibility
* Strong coordination, facilitation, problem-solving, and escalation skills
* Ability to interpret reports, identify issues, and coordinate appropriate remediation
* Ability to work independently within approved plans, procedures, and delegated authority

Capabilities:

* Able to travel based on study and business need
* Able to perform office-based or remote work as assigned
* Minor lifting of less than 30 pounds may be required

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Position Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Business Consultant to join our consulting team focused on the group benefit and retirement, specifically catering to US group benefit, group insurance and retirement clients. The ideal candidate will possess 3 to 8 years of relevant experience for Senior level a strong understanding of the insurance industry, and exceptional consulting skills. This is a full-time position that offers the opportunity to work on impactful projects and drive value for our clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage consulting projects for US group benefit and retirement clients, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze client needs, develop tailored solutions, and implement best practices.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities within the insurance sector.
* Develop and present comprehensive reports and recommendations to clients, showcasing insights and actionable strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their business challenges and providing expert guidance.
* Mentor and support junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Stay updated on industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging trends to provide informed consulting services.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Qualifications:**

* Full-time MBA from a reputable institution.
* 3 to 8 years of experience in business consulting, with a focus on the insurance sector, particularly group benefits and retirement.
* Strong domain knowledge of insurance process, products, regulations, and market dynamics.
* Proven consulting skills, including project management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong client management skills, with a focus on building lasting relationships and delivering exceptional service.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
