title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
**SRMB Srijan Private Limited is Hiring:**

**Head of Data Analytics (Kolkata)**

SRMB Srijan Private Limited is looking for a dynamic Head of Data Analytics to lead project

intelligence and sales analytics exclusively for our Government and Institutional Project

Sales vertical in Kolkata.

Reporting Structure: This position reports directly and exclusively to the VP - Institutional

Sales.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between big data and enterprise sales, governing our

project intelligence register, optimizing lead scoring models, and providing direct visibility

to our executive leadership.

**Core Technical Responsibilities**

**Data Retrieval:**
Architect automated API connectors, web-scraping workflows, and

ingestion pipelines to unify paid portal bulk downloads (CSV, Excel, PDF dumps) and

custom EPC/consultant web feeds into a deduplicated Project Intelligence Register with

a strict 24-hour validation SLA.

**Comprehending:**
Execute entity-resolution, automated relevance classification by

sector/lifecycle, and structural validation to isolate addressable steel and building

material demand from total project costs.

**Action:**
Engineer transparent, stochastic lead-merit algorithms and graph-linkage controls

mapping authority approvals, site source approvals, and plant capacities to qualified

sales opportunities.

**Distribution:**
Programmatically deploy multidimensional Power BI/Tableau data models,

approval gap matrices, and automated opportunity assignments across the project sales

vertical.

**Feedback:**
Operationalize closed-loop sales tracking, win-loss cohort analyses, and real-

time financial reconciliation dashboards to present conversion insights and metric-

driven decisions directly to the VP - Institutional Sales.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Education:**
Master’s degree or equivalent in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics,

Information Management, or a related field (technical graduate qualifications with

relevant postgraduate analytics credentials are also welcome).

**Experience:**
8+ or more years in sales or business analytics, with at least 3 years leading

analysts or data operations.

**Industry Expertise:**
Direct experience in the steel or building materials industry and

government or institutional project sales analytics is mandatory.

**Technical Stack:**
Hands-on proficiency in advanced Excel and SQL, along with Power BI or

Tableau and Python or R for data preparation and analysis.

**Location: Based in Kolkata (Full-time role with authorized project and authority visits as required).**

**What We Offer**

• A high-impact senior leadership role shaping national infrastructure and industrial

growth.

• The opportunity to build and mentor a high-performing pan-India Data Analytics team.

• Competitive compensation aligned with executive responsibilities.

Interested candidates may apply directly or reach out with an updated resume highlighting

major accomplishments and background.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Strategy Associate- Clinical
description:
Strategy Associate – Clinical Services,

Research & Evaluation

Department: CEO’s Office

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: Minimum 5 years

Compensation: Up to ₹10 LPA

Qualification: MA/MSc in Psychology

Role Overview

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational

development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate with a background in psychology, research, and

programme evaluation to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a

specialist focus on clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy, learning and

development, and research.

You will play a key role in evaluating programme effectiveness, service quality, implementation

progress, resource utilisation, and outcomes. The role will combine quantitative and qualitative

analysis with structured performance reviews to identify gaps, assess underlying causes,

recommend improvements, and monitor follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Performance Monitoring

● Monitor departmental plans, programmes, and organisation-wide strategic priorities

against agreed objectives, deliverables, quality standards, resource requirements,

budgets, and timelines.

● Review progress across clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy,

learning and development, and research.

● Monitor relevant indicators such as programme milestones, service quality, participant

outcomes, staff training effectiveness, research deliverables, and implementation

progress.

● Identify deviations from planned outcomes, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed

corrective actions.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review

● Develop or apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks, performance indicators,

evaluation criteria, and reporting mechanisms across departments, programmes,

projects, and strategic initiatives.

● Assess programme implementation, service quality, participant outcomes, training

effectiveness, research progress, and adherence to established standards, as

applicable.

● Review relevant workflows, documentation, assessment processes, referral pathways,

follow-up mechanisms, and service continuity within the scope of established protocols.

● Identify recurring gaps, implementation bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement;

prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations.

● Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and

track agreed corrective actions through closure.

3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation

● Identify gaps in organisational and programme systems and support the development of

appropriate structures, policies, SOPs, workflows, indicators, and accountability

mechanisms.

● Map and evaluate programme workflows, participant journeys, research processes,

training pathways, and service-delivery mechanisms.

● Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of established processes across relevant

departments.

● Evaluate the implementation of evidence-based practices and staff development

initiatives, where applicable.

4. Risk Monitoring & Management

● Monitor risks relating to programme implementation, service quality, documentation,

research milestones, staff capacity, resource constraints, and delivery timelines.

● Maintain relevant risk registers and track mitigation plans in collaboration with

accountable teams.

● Identify emerging risks, recurring quality concerns, and deviations from established

standards.

● Escalate material concerns to the leadership and monitor agreed mitigation actions

through closure.

● Respect confidentiality, ethical research requirements, and responsible handling of

participant and organisational data.

5. Research, Data Analysis & Leadership Reporting

● Consolidate quantitative and qualitative data from relevant departments and assess its

completeness, consistency, and usefulness for decision-making.

● Analyse participant feedback, programme outcomes, service-quality indicators, training

results, research milestones, and other relevant evidence.

● Prepare dashboards, evaluation reports, management summaries, and presentations for

departmental and organisation-wide reviews.

● Translate findings into clear insights and practical recommendations for leadership.

6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability

● Work with clinical, vocational, training, research, learning and development, and

operational teams to review performance and understand implementation challenges.

● Facilitate periodic reviews, document agreed actions, identify accountable owners, and

monitor completion against deadlines.

● Identify dependencies between programme teams and other organisational functions

that may affect delivery.

● Escalate persistent performance gaps, unresolved actions, and material risks through

the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes

● Reliable evidence on programme effectiveness, service quality, research progress, and

organisational performance.

● Stronger visibility into departmental progress against agreed objectives, quality

standards, resource requirements, and timelines.

● Early identification of implementation gaps, risks, and recurring performance issues.

● More consistent use of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and evidence-based

recommendations.

● Stronger implementation of organisational systems, documentation standards, and

improvement actions.

● Timely, accurate reports that support leadership decisions and continuous improvement.

Must-have Requirements

● 5 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, programme evaluation,

research, quality assurance, clinical or educational operations, or service-quality

management.

● MA/MSc in Psychology or a related discipline.

● Demonstrated ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and evaluate

programme or organisational performance.

● Experience preparing reports, reviewing processes, documenting findings, and

recommending improvements.

● Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and

stakeholder-coordination skills.

● Proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, and reporting tools.

● Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and follow through on agreed

actions.

● Understanding of confidentiality and ethical handling of sensitive information.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks, logic models, outcome

measurement, or programme evaluation.

● Familiarity with clinical, educational, vocational, psychosocial, or disability-service

settings.

● Exposure to research methodologies, statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.

● Knowledge of quality assurance, service standards, assessment protocols, or

evidence-based practices.

● Experience evaluating training, competency development, or programme

implementation.

● Experience working in healthcare, education, research, non-profit, or social-impact

organisations.

About India Autism Center

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of

support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of

life for individuals and families across India.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Company Description**
Digital Wolf is a collaborative team of innovative digital marketers focused on helping businesses succeed in a competitive online environment. The company specializes in tailored digital marketing strategies that align with each client’s unique goals and growth plans. By combining cutting-edge technology with data-driven insights, Digital Wolf designs campaigns that maximize performance and return on investment. A strong customer-centric approach ensures long-term partnerships, continuous optimization, and measurable results for clients across industries.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Performance Marketer role based in Kolkata. The Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize paid digital campaigns across channels such as search, social, and display to drive measurable business outcomes. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing ad platforms, monitoring campaign performance, analyzing key metrics, and implementing A/B tests to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine targeting, messaging, and landing pages, while preparing performance reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. The Performance Marketer will also stay updated on industry trends and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Campaign Strategy and Planning**

* Understand client/business objectives, target audience, offerings, funnel and conversion goals.
* Develop performance marketing strategies based on business objectives and available budgets.
* Plan campaign structures, audience strategy, creatives, messaging, placements and budgets.
* Define relevant KPIs and benchmarks before campaign launch.
* Develop full-funnel strategies across awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversion and remarketing, wherever relevant.

**2.**
**Campaign Execution**

* Independently set up, launch and manage campaigns across
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Manage campaign objectives, targeting, placements, budgets, bidding, ad sets/ad groups and creatives.
* Set up and monitor conversion events, pixels/tags and other relevant tracking requirements.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure campaigns have the right assets and messaging.
* Conduct campaign launches, checks and troubleshooting independently.

**3. Campaign Optimization**

* Monitor campaigns regularly and identify performance trends, anomalies and opportunities.
* Optimize campaigns based on
  **CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate and other relevant metrics**
  .
* Conduct audience, creative, placement, budget and bidding optimization.
* Run structured A/B tests and document learnings.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action instead of simply increasing or decreasing budgets.
* Scale campaigns when performance and business economics support it.

**4. Tracking & Analytics**

* Understand campaign tracking, conversion tracking and attribution fundamentals.
* Work with tools such as
  **GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/Events Manager and UTM tracking**
  .
* Analyse user journeys and conversion funnels to identify drop-offs.
* Ensure campaign data is reliable before drawing performance conclusions.

**5. Reporting & Insights**

* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
* Go beyond reporting numbers to explain
  **why performance changed and what should be done next**
  .
* Present campaign performance, key learnings, challenges and optimization recommendations to internal teams and clients.
* Connect advertising metrics with actual business outcomes such as qualified leads, sales, revenue and customer acquisition cost.

**6. Client & Team Collaboration**

* Communicate campaign strategy, performance and recommendations clearly to clients.
* Understand client requirements and proactively identify opportunities or concerns.
* Coordinate with social media, creative, content and design teams for campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple campaigns/accounts while maintaining timelines and performance standards.
* Take ownership of assigned accounts with minimal supervision.

**Required Skills**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Meta Ads Manager**
  .
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Google Ads**
  .
* Experience managing campaigns from
  **planning to reporting**
  .
* Strong understanding of lead generation and conversion campaigns.
* Good understanding of campaign tracking and attribution.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data and derive actionable insights.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts/campaigns simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing funnels and customer journeys.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with
  **Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio**
  .
* Experience with CRM integration and lead-quality tracking.
* Experience with lead-generation businesses such as
  **education, real estate, healthcare, B2B or services**
  .
* Experience with remarketing and full-funnel campaigns.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency environment.

title: Manager Operations-Private Equity
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager Operations.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators/SMEs to achieve target KPIs. Supporting Fund Services - Accounting & Valuation and financial reporting, covering Europe, MENA, APAC for multiple clients
* The role will demand a daily balance of delivering excellent client service within the Valuations and Reporting converged model of promoting continuous improvement of processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies
* The major challenge for this role is to continuously manage deliveries within the specified time limit with minimum or no errors. Manage 8 to 10 direct reports, whilst overseeing additional headcount (indirect reports), as and when required by business
* Given the criticality of the process, this role requires the job holder to adhere to process and GMP guidelines to ensure NIL impact to the business. Any exceptions, failures, inaccuracies or delays could potentially result in any of the following impacts.
* Engagement with Business partners to understand and work on improving customer satisfaction

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Location:**
West Bengal, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 - 45 LPA

**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Beauty, Cosmetic, Perfumes, Alcohol business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand & Production Planning**

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**End-to-End Vendor Management**

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

**Production & Component Coordination**

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

**Inventory & Availability**

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

**Cost & Process Optimisation**

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

**International Supply Chain**

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

**Key Deliverables / Success Metrics**

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

**Ideal Candidate**

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, Alcohol, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery, Alcohol or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

* Review and approve:

+ Migration design documents
+ BODS architecture and job designs
+ Data validation and reconciliation strategies

* Proactively identify migration risks and define mitigation plans
* Support presales activities including:

+ Solutioning
+ Effort estimation
+ Technical inputs for proposals

**People & Delivery Responsibilities**

* Manage and mentor BODS developers (junior to senior levels)
* Assign and monitor work, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines
* Establish and enforce development standards and best practices
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and technical walkthroughs
* Build a strong quality‑driven and ownership‑focused delivery culture
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations
* Drive internal capability building, accelerators, and reusable assets

**Technical Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in SAP data migration with strong BODS focus
* Proven track record of leading multiple end‑to‑end migration cycles
* Expert‑level knowledge of:

+ SAP BODS architecture, design, and performance optimization
+ Jobs, dataflows, workflows, transformations, and error handling

* Strong hands‑on experience with:

+ ECC to S/4HANA data migration
+ SAP source and target systems

* Hands‑on exposure to:

+ S/4HANA Data Migration Cockpit (LTMC / Fiori Migration Object Modeler)
+ IDOC / BAPI based integrations using BODS

* Advanced SQL skills for complex data analysis and issue resolution
* Functional understanding of SAP process areas like Finance, Sales and Distribution, Material Management etc
* Experience in:

+ BODS installation, configuration, scheduling, and Management Console
+ Migration mock cycles, dress rehearsals, and cutover execution

* Ability to produce:

+ Migration strategies
+ Technical architectures
+ Detailed effort estimates and plans

* Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL best practices

**What We Look For**

* Strong technical leadership with hands‑on credibility
* Proven ability to manage complex, high‑volume data migrations
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

title: Senior Product Owner, BI & Analytics
description:

Join Danfoss as a
**Senior Product Owner, BI & Analytics**
and shape how data supports decisions across our global business. You will lead the direction of enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, and emerging conversational BI solutions.
  
  
You will turn complex business needs into
**trusted, intuitive, and scalable analytics products**
. By connecting people, data, and technology, you will make insights easier to access, understand, and use.
  
  
Working across business and technology teams, you will balance immediate priorities with a long-term product strategy. Your work will strengthen trusted reporting, expand self-service analytics, and help modernize our BI landscape.
  
  
The preferred work mode would be hybrid.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Set the product direction for reporting, agents, and analytics solutions by defining the vision, roadmap, priorities, and product lifecycle.
* Turn business needs into clear priorities, user stories, features, and acceptance criteria that guide cross-functional development teams.
* Bring teams together across business, data engineering, analytics, architecture, and technology platforms to deliver valuable and user-friendly solutions.
* Build trust by promoting consistent definitions, reusable semantic models, clear ownership, and strong standards for quality, privacy, security, and access.
* Increase adoption and business value by improving user experiences, enabling self-service and conversational BI, and measuring usage, reliability, satisfaction, and time to insight.

**What We're Looking For**

* Proven experience in BI, analytics, democratization, data products, or digital product management, including ownership of product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs, and lifecycles.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise reporting, data visualization, semantic models, data quality, and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience translating complex business and analytical needs into practical priorities for cross-functional technology teams.
* A solid understanding of agile product development and the ability to make balanced decisions based on value, user needs, feasibility, risk, and long-term sustainability.
* Experience working with and enabling self-managing teams, fostering ownership while providing clear priorities, strategic direction, and decision-making support.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, together with professional proficiency in English.

**What You'll Get From Us**

* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.
* We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

**people, data, and technology**

title: Specialist - Business Analyst & Application Support
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
Specialist - Business Analyst & Application Support
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req32593**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Specialist in this role will analyse/understand business requirements, review functional specifications and test plans, and support validation topics and audit activities. The person will also be responsible for providing ongoing application support within the Business Applications Bulk & PGP domain to help the organisation achieve its operational and strategic business goals.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* The Specialist in this role will be responsible to maintain system documentation in compliance with GxP standards
* And create and maintain SOPs, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), and other technical documentation
* You will also support and maintenance of software solutions supporting the Cylinder Supply Chain domain
* And analyse / understand business requirements and support functional design and testing activities
* Lastly, participate in system validation and support & internal and external audits
* You must have knowledge of system specification and modelling and proficiency in GxP validation

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* A Bachelor/master's degree in computer science, Information Technology or equivalent from a reputed institute and formal training on validation topics & audit
* You should have overall three to four (3 - 4) years of relevant IT experience working with reputed companies
* Also, knowledge in mobile, web, client server development using Microsoft technology
* Must have experience in working in offshore teams and exposure to working in a geographically dispersed environment
* Lastly, Ability to work across multiple time zones
* You must have knowledge in C#, .NET, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
* Must possess knowledge in MVC architecture & RESTful APIs, web services, and server-side technologies
* And strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement
* Support CDM Operations, Geo Sales Operations, and Data-to-Value teams with issue resolution, data loads, mass data updates, and technical guidance.
* Develop SQL-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Apply deep understanding of CDM business processes and related enterprise systems, including ERP, PLM, CRM, and the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication & Enablement
* Work closely with technology and operations teams to ensure successful, sustainable delivery of CDM systems, including transitions to IT operations.
* Provide regular project and operational updates (weekly/monthly), and confidently brief executive audiences to support informed, proactive decision-making.
* Report risks, issues, and progress to IT leadership, escalating as appropriate.
* Develop, deliver, and support training for CDM operations and key user teams, enabling adoption and effective system usage.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Background:**
**Work History:**

* 5+ years of experience in designing solutions and defining requirements for CDM platforms and complex IT systems, including hands-on experience with databases, SQL, ETL processes, and related data systems..
* Excellent communication skills and customer service skills
* Must have strong problem-solving ability, critical thinking skills, creative/innovative thinking, attention to detail, and previous systems/business analyst experience.
* Must show positive attitude, strong self-motivation, ability to meet deadlines, and ability to determine appropriate sense of urgency.
* Good understanding of software development life cycles.

**Technical Competence:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related field.
* Expertise in Data warehouse and ETL tools like BODS (Business Objects Data Services), DataStage, Business Objects, AWS Aurora and AWS Redshift.
* Must have knowledge in IT Development, Production support or Operations area.
* Extensive working experience in SQL Query or other programming languages.
* Must have knowledge in Microsoft office tools, particularly Excel, VBA and Access.
* Nice to have knowledge of web applications, portals and document management tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of webMethods or any such integration tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of SAP HANA, Microsoft D365, Enovia or similar tools in ERP, CRM and PLM.
* Nice to have knowledge in Power Platform apps, Power BI, Power App, Power Automate/ Flow.
* Experience in project management skills.

**Skills:**

* Oral & Written Communication.
* Strong problem solving, critical thinking
* Ability to be a global team player, communicate and work well in a collaborative environment.
* Be proactive in resolving issues and delivering business solutions.
* Handling Confidential & Sensitive Data & Information.
* Process Facilitation.

NA

* Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences

* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others

* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Anaplan/Tagetik/Oracle PBCS and EPBCS/Power BI/Tableau/OneStream/Board and relevant EPM tools

* GBS/SSC Setup
* Project management skills, IFRS Implementation / IFRS Reporting Experience
* Exposure to tools like ERP, EPM tools, Visio, ARIS, etc.

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Opportunities to work with EY Advisory practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from world’s top companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

title: Supervisor, Credits, Incentives and Methods
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Expert Consultation: Preparation of higher complexity SR&ED tax incentive claims and assist with review of claims as required. Maintaining regular contact with assigned clients – communicating directly with client personnel in operations, finance, accounting, payroll, and engineering – and their accountants to gather relevant information to prepare project costing and complete tax return input.
* Client Partnership: Cultivate strong relationships with clients to uncover SR&ED opportunities, offering bespoke consultation and support throughout the SR&ED claim lifecycle. Meet with clients in-person and virtually to establish engagement plans, assist with evaluation of eligible activities, and gather supporting documentation. Provide timely, high quality client service that meets or exceeds their expectations.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner with our adept technical team to identify eligible costs, formulate strategic plans, and guarantee a seamless claims process. Enhance the SR&ED claim journey for clients, implementing streamlined approaches that ensure efficiency as client satisfaction is paramount.
* Claim Defense: Be the advocate for your assigned clients in interactions with Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) and provincial bodies to work in our client’s best interest, leading them through the FTCAS or Review/Audit process, gather and submit requested information and documents, and attending CRA or provincial meetings.
* Financial Advisory: Offer specialized advice on tax credits and deductions, ensuring alignment with clients’ fiscal goals and optimizing financial gains. Stay abreast of changes to SR&ED federal and provincial programs and other relevant tax incentives. Comfortable with research as required, reviewing the Income Tax Act, CRA policies, and relevant case law.
* Business Insights: Cultivate a comprehensive understanding of clients’ operational landscapes, leading multiple engagements to success with informed strategies. Stay up to date with relevant internal and external professional development, pursue ongoing education opportunities.

title: SAP CCM
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

description:

**Job Title:**
Lead Architect / Senior Solution Architect

**Workstream:**
Legacy Reporting Modernisation

**Primary Tech Stack:**
Oracle DB (SQL/PLSQL), OAS, BI Publisher, Python

**Legacy Stack:**
Microsoft Access / VBA / Macros

**Environment:**
Enterprise / Production-Grade

**Engagement Type:**
Full-Time

**1. Executive Summary**

We are looking for an experienced
**Lead Oracle Analytics, Python & Access Reporting Modernisation Architect**
to lead the end-to-end migration of a mission-critical Microsoft Access reporting platform to a modernized, enterprise-grade architecture.

In this role, you will analyze legacy MS Access applications connected to Oracle databases, re-architect complex business logic, and construct a scalable replacement using
**Oracle Analytics Server (OAS)**
,
**BI Publisher**
,
**Oracle SQL/PLSQL**
, and
**Python automation**
. You will serve as the single lead owner delivering this solution end-to-end.

**2. Core Responsibilities**
**A. Discovery & Architecture Assessment**

* Audit and inventory legacy MS Access databases (.mdb/.accdb), linked Oracle tables, pass-through queries, forms, macros, and VBA modules.
* Document current-state reporting workflows, schedules, distribution rules, data refresh intervals, and manual interventions.
* Evaluate migration complexity to select the optimal target pattern:
  **OAS-Only**
  ,
  **Python-Only**
  ,
  **Python + OAS**
  , or a
  **Python Web Portal**
  .

**B. Oracle Database Engineering & Tuning**

* Convert complex Access SQL queries and embedded VBA logic into robust Oracle SQL, views, materialized views, and PL/SQL packages.
* Perform high-volume database performance tuning using AWR/ASH reports, execution plans, parallel processing, and TEMP/PGA management.
* Implement secure DB connection methods, service account configurations, least-privilege policies, and release controls.

**C. OAS & BI Publisher Development**

* Build interactive OAS dashboards, analyses, prompts, custom filters, and drill-down capabilities.
* Create BI Publisher data models, layouts (RTF/Excel/PDF/CSV), bursting definitions, and automated execution schedules.
* Migrate Access reports into governed OAS assets aligned with enterprise security models, roles, and folder structures.

**D. Python Reporting & Workflow Automation**

* Design Python jobs using pandas, oracledb/cx\_Oracle, SQLAlchemy, openpyxl, XlsxWriter, and NumPy to automate data extraction, transformation, and output generation.
* Build audit logging, exception handling, automated retry mechanisms, and data reconciliation checks into all Python jobs.
* Integrate execution workflows with enterprise schedulers such as
  **Control-M**
  ,
  **AutoSys**
  , or
  **Windows Task Scheduler**

The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.

* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.

* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

title: Senior Analyst -I Kolkata
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
  
  
Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
  
  
We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
  
  
**About The Position**
A Senior Analyst I works with our clients (banks and non-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing both quality control work related to the work of our Associate Analysts, and performing his/her own detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures. In short, you are on the front-line of making decisions as to how to keep clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.
  
  
As a Senior Analyst I, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
  
  
You may perform quality control activities, supervisory responsibility on occasion and be responsible for ad hoc communication with client. You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work, and you must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures, escalating where appropriate for second level review· Ability to perform quality control work as needed.
* Assist with advanced tasks including communication with clients, analyzing production data and creating client specific aids and training.
* Independently assist analyst with workflow items and administrative tasks as they arise.
* Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.
* Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.
* Work and contribute in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.
* Adhere to and comply with all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti-Money, as well as adhering to company policies and procedures and client requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 2-3 year of relevant AML/BSA experience.
* Strong oral communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint & Microsoft Word, with ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Certification
* Strong knowledge of banking industry and related regulations and laws.
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities for improvement.

**Normal Working Hours and Conditions**
Core business hours are generally 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. However, this position may require work to be performed outside of the core business hours based on Company operations across different time zones.
  
  
AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise-grade decision-making.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
